title: Liang Sze Jang And Tsai Chi Seng, Reference Letter From Netherlands Consulate-General Dated January 15, 1934

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
No. 321.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. R. REGISTRY.
No. D. 5654
Date 1 / 2 1934
SHANGHAI, 1st February 1934.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge the
receipt of your letter of 30 January 1934,
No.D.5654 concerning Liang and Tsai and
to thank you for the information contained
therein.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Chinese Secretary.

T.Robertson,Esquire,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（批：Reg

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. D. REGISTRY.
No. D 5654
Date 30 / 1 / 34

January 30 34.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter No.91 of January 15, 1934, and to
state that a comparison between the photographs
of Liang Sze Jang (梁自強) and Tsai Chi Seng (蔡奇生),
copies of which have been obtained from the Chinese
Authorities and are attached herewith, shows that
they are different persons.

The photograph of Liang Sze Jang forwarded
with your letter is returned herewith.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

for Officer i/c Special Branch.

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General.

（左侧批注：x Enclosed: 3 photos.
add of）

1934 年 1 月 30 日。

先生：

随函退回您来信中附带的梁自強照片。

此致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，

代特别股主管警官。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. D 5654 M. D 5654）
Date January 29, 19 34

Subject (in full) Liang Sze Jang(梁自強) and Tsai Chi Seng(蔡奇生), reference
letter from Netherlands Consulate-General dated January 15, 1934.
Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Everest

x See D 5242
In answer to the attached letter dated January 15, 1934,
from the Netherlands Consulate-General enclosing a photograph of
a Javanese named Liang Sze Jang(梁自強) and asking whether
this person is identical with one Tsai Chi Seng (蔡奇生), who
was arrested by the Chinese Authorities on August 18, 1933, and
released on September 27 of the same year, I enclose herewith
photographs of Liang Sze Jang and Tsai Chi Seng which prove
beyond doubt that they are different persons.
The photographs were obtained from the Shanghai Bureau of
Public Safety.

Attached for Neth. Consul: / D.I. Everest.
1) Original photograph of Liang Sze Jang.
2) Copies of photographs of Liang Sze Jang & Tsai Chi Seng.
3) Received from Chinese Authorities.
Copy of Report.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

D.I.
JWP

主题（全称）梁自強（Liang Sze Jang）和蔡奇生（Tsai Chi Seng），参照荷兰总领事馆 1934 年 1 月 15 日来信。
撰写及呈送人：督察长 Everest

x 参见 D 5242
针对所附荷兰总领事馆 1934 年 1 月 15 日来信，该信附有一名名为梁自強（Liang Sze Jang）的爪哇人的照片，并询问此人是否与蔡奇生（Tsai Chi Seng）为同一人；蔡奇生于 1933 年 8 月 18 日被中国当局逮捕，并于同年 9 月 27 日获释。现随函附上梁自強和蔡奇生的照片，这些照片确凿无疑地证明二人并非同一人。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 91 .

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5654
Date 17 / 1 / 34

SHANGHAI, 15 January 1934 .

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to my letter of 29 November
1933 No.3427 (your number 16 November 1933,D.4900),and to
enclose herewith a photograph of a person calling himself
Liang Sze fang Niu Chu-kiong (梁自強) who came to the notice of the
Police in Singapore and who appears to have been arrested
by the Public Safety Bureau in Shanghai on 10.11.32 as the
result of information given against him by a fellow student
to the effect that he was a member of the Chinese Communist
Party. He was never actually sentenced to any term of
imprisonment, but was released on security put up by the
Chao Kwang Middle School, No.103 Seymour Road, Shanghai
(formally known as the Middle School for Overseas Chinese).
According to the Public Safety Bureau no evidence was pro-
duced against him which would justify regarding him as a
confirmed communist.

As it is possible that he is the same person as Tjhai
Khi-sen (蔡奇生) alias Tsai Chi-seng alias Tsa Ghi-seng,
mentioned in my letter quoted above, I would be much obliged
to know whether the two persons are identical.

Kindly return the annex after you have made use thereof.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Chinese Secretary.

T.P.Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（批：Returned 3/3/1933）
（批：S. 2 For attention HR）

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
AD. HOLLANDIA。

第 91 号。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
D 5654 号
日期 34 年 1 月 17 日

上海，1934 年 1 月 15 日。

先生：

谨此提及我 1933 年 11 月 29 日的第 3427 号信件（贵方编号为 1933 年 11 月 16 日，D.4900），并随函附上一张自称梁自強牛楚琼（Liang Sze fang Niu Chu-kiong (梁自強)）之人的照片。此人曾引起新加坡警方注意，且似乎因一名同学举报其为中国共产党成员，而于 1932 年 11 月 10 日被上海公安局逮捕。他实际上从未被判任何监禁刑期，而是由上海西摩路 103 号的肇光中学（前身为华侨中学）提供担保后获释。据公安局称，并未提出足以将其视为既定共产党员的证据。

由于他有可能与我上述引用信件中提到的 Tjhai Khi-sen（蔡奇生），又名 Tsai Chi-seng，又名 Tsa Ghi-seng 为同一人，如蒙告知二人是否身份相同，我将不胜感激。

使用完毕后，请退还附件。

此致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，

华务秘书。

T. P. Givens 先生，
特别股主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（批注：1933 年 3 月 3 日退回）
（批注：S. 2 供 HR 阅知）
